description: This file defines interfaces and classes for message output and publishing within the WPEFramework, including console, syslog, file, JSON, UDP, and WebSocket outputs, as well as message formatting and command handling.

classes.name: IPublish
classes.description: Interface for publishing messages with a Message method.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Class for converting message info and text, with constructor deleted and a convert method.

classes.name: ConsoleOutput
classes.description: Implements IPublish, outputs messages to console.

classes.name: SyslogOutput
classes.description: Implements IPublish, outputs messages to syslog.

classes.name: FileOutput
classes.description: Implements IPublish, outputs messages to a file.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Handles JSON formatted message output with configurable options.

classes.name: JSON::Data
classes.description: JSON container class for message data.

classes.name: UDPOutput
classes.description: Implements IPublish, outputs messages over UDP.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput
classes.description: Implements IPublish, manages WebSocket connections for message output and command handling.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput::ExportCommand
classes.description: JSON container for export command configuration.
